scope: Twelve fighters in the six matchups with established canonical identities.

stat_definitions.significant_strikes_landed_per_minute: SLpM; significant strikes landed per minute, as shown in current official rate panel.
stat_definitions.significant_strikes_absorbed_per_minute: SApM; significant strikes absorbed per minute.
stat_definitions.significant_strike_accuracy_display_pct: Rounded percentage displayed by official striking accuracy chart. Raw landed/attempted totals are retained separately.
stat_definitions.significant_strike_defense_pct: Percentage of opponents significant strike attempts that do not land.
stat_definitions.takedowns_average_per_15_minutes: Average successful takedowns per15minutes, as reported.
stat_definitions.takedown_defense_pct: Percentage of opponents takedown attempts that do not land; null if source absent.
stat_definitions.aggregate_totals: Present-day publisher career/coverage totals, not per-fight count observations.
stat_definitions.reach_cm: Converted from UFC profile reach in inches using2.54cm/in.

limitations: All data were actually observed October19,2026. These aggregates are suitable for current matchup context and cannot reconstruct what was available before historical fights.
Existing v4 was fitted without this reach/stat source; merely adding visible source facts does not make its probabilities use these statistics.

Historical model enrichment needs dated per-fight paired landed/attempted observations, stable identity/bout mapping and a new frozen evaluation. No current career average is backfilled as a historical feature.
Publisher total and rate panels are retained as separately reported fields; common coverage and exact cross-panel reconciliation are not assumed.
Aaron Pico takedown defense is absent from the captured official source, and stays null.

Official takedown accuracy chart percentages are omitted from normalized report facts. Exact published panels are retained for source audit; other current statistics are reported as supplied and do not establish common cross-panel coverage.

Current official reach and pinned UFCStats mirror reach differ by half an inch for five fighters. Both measurements are retained separately; any model uses its declared archive source and must not silently overwrite one with the other.
data_quality_notes: Normalized takedown accuracy display is omitted for all12fighters because the official chart/count panels include incomplete or materially discordant values for5fighters and their common coverage is undocumented. The11published percentages and the1absent value remain exactly preserved under published_source_display; raw source files and receipts are unchanged. Other statistics remain source-reported descriptive context. No corrected percentages, takedown counts or historical inputs are inferred.
